anomalies.description: A physical altercation occurs between two men on the left side of the room: a bald man in a dark shirt and another man in a white t-shirt. The fight involves grabbing, pushing, and swinging motions; at ~2.0s, the man in white lifts and throws a yellow plastic chair toward the bald man, who is struck or dodges. The struggle continues with repeated grappling and strikes through frame f15 (7.5s). Other people at tables observe but do not intervene directly during this interval.

A bald man in a dark blue shirt engages in mutual physical combat with multiple individuals around a dining table, including throwing and swinging a yellow plastic chair, while others intervene or join the scuffle.

A physical altercation occurs involving at least three individuals: a man in a white shirt, a man in dark clothing, and a third person (possibly female) who is on the ground or being subdued. The man in white actively engages with the others, pulling, pushing, and at times appearing to strike. The struggle moves across the floor near tables and chairs, with chairs knocked over and objects displaced. The fight persists throughout the sequence, with dynamic changes in positioning but continuous mutual physical contact.

During the ongoing fight, one individual (wearing light-colored top, possibly female) is repeatedly on the ground or in a vulnerable position while being physically engaged by others—specifically, being held down, pulled by hair/clothing, and struck. This suggests targeted aggression against a less able-to-defend participant, meeting the definition of abuse within the context of the fight.; After the initial mutual struggle, the person in dark clothing appears to dominate and continue aggressive actions against the other individual who is now on the ground and less responsive, suggesting a shift to one-sided abuse.

Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat on the floor near the left side of the room; one in dark clothing is on top of another in light clothing, with visible grappling and striking motions.; A man in a white shirt aggressively throws an orange plastic chair across the room, then stands up and moves rapidly toward the left side of the frame, suggesting an ongoing physical confrontation.

The man in the white shirt appears to strike or forcefully push someone seated at the foreground table (partially obscured), causing the person to recoil; the victim remains seated and does not retaliate during this interval.
The person in light clothing rises and re-engages physically with the other individual, resulting in renewed mutual combat involving pushing and chair displacement.
